messages:
Maya Ortiz: Quick SEO micro-sync for the webinar + launch post. Need: campaign-safe redirects, canonical decision for /guestlist vs /register, JSON-LD event snippet, and 2 meta desc variants for preview. 10 min?

Liam O'Connor: I can take redirects. Lean 302 for promo links; 301 only if permanent. Will sketch nginx rules and a rollback tag.

Priya Nair: Ill handle JSON-LD + OG/Twitter tags. Plan to include Event + FAQ markup to improve SERP real estate.

Ben Cho: Ill pull the top keywords from the benchmark narrative and write two meta descs: one conversion-focused, one informational.

Maya Ortiz: For canonical: /register is canonical for the official event page. /guestlist can self-canonicalize unless it duplicates full details. Add rel=canonical only when content matches.

Liam O'Connor: Redirect sketch:
```
/webinar/social -> /guestlist?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=may-webinar 302
/guestlist/submit -> /register?utm_source=guestlist&utm_campaign=may-webinar 302
/webinar/longform -> /register?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=webinar 301
```
Rollback: remove query params and re-point to prior landing.

Priya Nair: Tiny JSON-LD snippet I'll use in PR (will include unit test to assert presence):
`{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference: Inference at Scale","startDate":"2026-05-20T16:00:00Z","eventAttendanceMode":"https://schema.org/OnlineEventAttendanceMode","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://www.redwood.com/register"},"offers":{"@type":"Offer","price":"0","priceCurrency":"USD"}}`

Ben Cho: Keyword clusters (from benchmark):
- production inference webinar
- inference latency tips
- reduce inference costs
Ill add meta descs to the content doc shortly.

Maya Ortiz: Tracking: add utm_content for variant, utm_term for keyword cluster. Add GA4 event: webinar_register and funnel guestlist->register.

seo-bot: Staging crawl scheduled for 2026-04-03T04:00Z. Will post results to #marketing-crawl-results.

Liam O'Connor: Putting up the redirect PR now.

Priya Nair: Will attach JSON-LD tests and OG card examples.

Ben Cho: Meta descs dropped in the doc, pinging growth for quick preference vote.

Maya Ortiz: Thanks all — reconvene Tue 9am to confirm PRs and crawl. Ping here if blocked. :rocket:
